card.name: Words right after a quoted term
card.fires_on: Short common words (pronouns, 'the', 'be', 'his') or word parts that come soon after a quoted phrase or term in running prose. The model seems to be expecting that no further quotation mark opens next.

modes.label: Pronoun or helper word after quote
modes.description: A pronoun or short linking word such as they, you, his, be, or the in a sentence that has recently used quotation marks.
modes.example: You don't know what<< they>>'re going to do with it." Like

modes.label: Inside a quoted name or term
modes.description: A word or word part inside or just after a quoted name or label.
modes.example: Dongfan "<<Greg>>" Chung volunteered to spy for China.

card.writes: It lowers the chance of a straight double quote opening next, and raises odd code-style tokens, so it adds little.
card.plain: It fires on small words in ordinary text near quoted terms, where another quote mark is not expected.
